'''Qinghe''' is an actress NPC in [[Jinzhou]], found nearby Jinzhou Theater stage. At night, she moves around the back stage.

==Location==
{{Map Embed|Jinzhou|111;91|nogroup=1}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(First interaction)
:'''Qinghe:''' Once I pick up the Torch Sword, I'll eradicate that monster—
:'''Qinghe:''' Are you here to watch the show? How did you sneak backstage?
:'''Qinghe:''' Silent flame, lurking evils—the show hasn't started. Go and have some rest first, and wait for Fiamma's grand entrance!
----
;<nowiki>06:00-17:59</nowiki>
:'''Qinghe:''' Oh, it's you. What brings you here?
:'''Qinghe:''' Running around every day, you must have a busy schedule, just like the protagonist in my play...
:'''Qinghe:''' In the Hero Play, the protagonist, before embarking on a grand mission, always has to deal with some trivial matters first. I guess that's part of the story.
----
;<nowiki>18:00-21:59</nowiki>
:'''Qinghe''': Oh, it's you. Perfect timing, I was just thinking about something. I'd like to hear your opinion.
:'''Qinghe''': If you were the hero, enlighten me: what would possess you to pick up the Torch Sword and fight to cleanse evils?
:{{DIcon}} For family and friends.
::'''Qinghe''': The lore for family, the bond with friends... So you put a high valuation on trust between those around you.
:{{DIcon}} For money and honor.
::'''Qinghe''': Exorcise demons and monsters and become an undying legend... You're seeking the right stuff!
:{{DIcon}} No reason.
::'''Qinghe''': Oh? But I see a firm and pure determination in your eyes. I guess it's not that you don't have a reason, but you're always ready to lend a hand, right?
:'''Qinghe''': So that's how it is... Wait, I've got an idea! Thanks, I'll get back to my rehearsal.
----
;<nowiki>22:00-05:59</nowiki> off the stage.
:'''Qinghe''': Hello, can I help you?
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Qinghe''': Oh, it's you! Got some free time to watch the play today, huh? If you have any questions, feel free to ask me.
::{{DIcon}} About Jinzhou Theater...
:::'''Qinghe''': Our Jinzhou Theater is open all year round, with Hero Plays, storytelling, and Liondancing taking turns on stage. We hope that all our audience members leave feeling entertained!
:::'''Qinghe''': During the holidays, we'll arrange some special performances. The Liondance Troupe, for example, will perform on the theater stage to welcome the {{tt|Spring Loong Festival|Referring to the Spring Festival which marks the end of Winter and the first day of the Lunisolar Calender}}.
:::'''Qinghe''': These Ushers will be walking around the streets, filling my heart with liveness. Quite the spectacle!
:::'''Qinghe''': Next up, the Torch Sword! Let its flames burn, let the sparks fly and lighten up tonight!
:::'''Qinghe''': Sorry, I got carried away again. Please forgive my manners.
::{{DIcon}} About Hero Play...
:::'''Qinghe''': I've performed this Hero Play hundreds, even thousands of times.
:::'''Qinghe''': Playing Fiamma over and over, it feels like we're becoming one entity.
:::'''Qinghe''': But you know, I'll keep playing the Fiamma role. After all, every time the show ends, I feel happy seeing the bright eyes of the children in the audience.
:::'''Qinghe''': If the performance can move and inspire people, it doesn't matter how tiring the rehearsals can be.
:::'''Qinghe''': It was [[Chixia]] who made me realize this. She was a dedicated audience to my play when she was a kid. Now she's a Patroller. More and more people will know her as Chixia!
:::'''Qinghe''': Well, I think she fits the real Fiamma of Jinzhou better than me. I'm happy for her.
::{{DIcon}} About the play...
:::'''Qinghe''': Same old arrangements. "Speedster" and "Fiamma" are taking turns to perform, making sure the Fluffernox doesn't wreak havoc on the human world.
:::'''Qinghe''': But we're also working on a new play. Don't forget to come and see it yourself when it's out!
::{{DIcon}} Nothing.
:::'''Qinghe''': Alright, feel free to look around. If you have any questions, just ask me.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
{{Dialogue End}}
